title: Small d and k
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3.5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 1.5 \times 10^5; 0 \leq M \leq \min (\frac{N(N-1)}{2},\frac{3N}{2}); 1 \leq a_i \lt b_i \leq N; (a_i,b_i) \neq (a_j,b_j), if i\neq j.; The degree of each vertex in the graph is at most 3.; 1 \leq Q \leq 1.5 \times 10^5; 1 \leq x_i \leq N; 0 \leq k_i \leq 3; All values in input are integers.
